name: Anduril Industries, Inc.

summary.text: Anduril Industries is a defense technology contractor specializing in autonomous systems, counter-UAS (Lattice OS), and maritime robotics. Founded in 2017 by Palmer Luckey and Trae Stephens (Founders Fund), it scaled rapidly via venture syndicates and defense procurement awards, surpassing a $30B valuation by 2025. Its relationship with sovereign capital bridges early strategic investment from In-Q-Tel with multi-billion-dollar enterprise contracts across the U.S. Army, SOCOM, and the Defense Innovation Unit (DIU).

connections.claim: DIU awarded Anduril a 5-year Production Other Transaction (P-OT) agreement for counter-UAS with a $99M ceiling in 2021.

sources.title: Anduril scores $99M contract with DIU for counter-drone tech
sources.addedBy: audit: found when the cited page did not carry the claim

connections.quote: By Jackson Barnett July 27, 2021 (Getty Images) The Department of Defense has awarded technology startup Anduril a $99 million contract to provide a new automated counter-unmanned aerial system (C-UAS) capability. The Production Other Transaction (P-OT) Agreement was struck between the company and the Defense Innovation Unit , the DOD's Silicon Valley outpost that uses non-traditional contracts to work with start ups.
